summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of the 150-room Embassy Suites by Hilton Dallas Near the Galleria to DG Lodging, LLC for $17 million in cash, subject to customary prorations. The transaction closed on May 6, 2026, pursuant to a March 26, 2026 purchase agreement. Net proceeds after selling expenses were approximately $16.6 million, and Ashford paid about $16.0 million to the mortgage lender, whose loan was secured by ten hotels including this property. Unaudited pro forma financials are attached as Exhibit 99.1. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. The filing is a straightforward post-closing disposition of a single asset. Watch for any redeployment of net cash proceeds or future hotel sales as part of Ashford’s portfolio strategy.
